intro: How much you can put into IRAs, the catch-up amount for people over 50, and the income ranges that limit Roth contributions and traditional IRA deductions.
explanation:
## One limit covers all your IRAs

The IRA contribution limit is {fact:us_ira_limit} for {tax_year}, and it applies to your traditional and Roth IRAs added together, not to each one. People aged 50 and over can add a catch-up contribution of {fact:us_ira_catchup}, a figure that SECURE 2.0 made subject to an annual cost-of-living adjustment.

## Traditional IRAs: your deduction depends on work coverage

Whether a traditional IRA contribution is deductible depends on certain conditions. What matters is whether you or your spouse took part in a workplace retirement plan during the year. If neither of you was, the phase-outs do not apply and the deduction is not reduced because of your income.

If you or your spouse was covered, the deduction shrinks as income rises and disappears at the top of a range. The range for a single taxpayer covered at work is {fact:us_ira_td_s_lo} to {fact:us_ira_td_s_hi}. For a married couple filing jointly where the contributing spouse is covered at work, it is {fact:us_ira_td_j_lo} to {fact:us_ira_td_j_hi}. If you are not covered at work but your spouse is, the range is {fact:us_ira_td_sp_lo} to {fact:us_ira_td_sp_hi}. A married person filing separately who is covered at work has a range that is not adjusted for inflation, from $0 to $10,000.

## Roth IRAs: income limits on contributing

Whether you can contribute to a Roth IRA depends on your income. The reduction range is {fact:us_ira_roth_s_lo} to {fact:us_ira_roth_s_hi} for single taxpayers and heads of household, and {fact:us_ira_roth_j_lo} to {fact:us_ira_roth_j_hi} for married couples filing jointly. For a married person filing separately, the range also stays at $0 to $10,000.

## Ranges rise and fall year to year

Most of these figures are adjusted each year for inflation. The separate-return ranges are the exception, because they are not adjusted. Saver's Credit and SIMPLE account limits are in the notice too.
